condo: Rare dual key 3b3b, vacant unit, walk to Pasir Ris Mrt

history.summary: A 1,216 sqft dual-key 99yr-leasehold 3BR (likely NV Residences, Pasir Ris, ~2013) at $1.7M / $1,398 PSF — above the project's ~$1,329 PSF 12-month average — and 1.09km (13 min) from Pasir Ris MRT. Dual-key niche format plus a leasehold OCR location with leasehold decay underway.
history.rating_rationale: $1,398 PSF sits above the ~$1,329 PSF recent project average, so it's priced a touch full, and the 1.09km MRT walk weakens what the listing markets as a transit play. Dual-key is a niche format (narrower resale pool) and the 99yr lease (from ~2008) is past its first decade. Against that: $1.7M quantum is liquid, the development is large (~642 units) and well-amenitied, and CRL Pasir Ris (~2030) is a future catalyst. Balanced — fine but unexciting investment.
